Fetching Data in a Real Application
In real frontend projects, you usually don't create promises yourself.
Most of the time, you use APIs that already return promises. One of the most common examples is fetch().
Instead of thinking about promises in abstract terms, it helps to see how they behave in a real situation.
Let's illuminate this with a simple and realistic example. Click Next Lesson to view the example.
